NIKIN THAMMAYYA S

Assistant Vice President – New Client Onboarding | KYC, AML, CLM | SLA, Risk & Controls | Capital Markets Operations Leader
📞 +91 9902722411 | ✉️ nikin.sagi@yahoo.com

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Seasoned Client Onboarding leader with 17+ years of experience in Capital Markets and Asset & Wealth Management, specializing in New Client Onboarding (NCO), KYC/AML compliance, and end-to-end client lifecycle management, Reference data Management & Client Data Management.

Proven ability to lead large onboarding teams across regions, manage SLAs/KPIs, drive onboarding strategy, and deliver technology and process transformation initiatives. Strong expertise in cross-functional alignment with Front Office, Trading, Legal, Credit, and Operations, ensuring seamless onboarding, reduced time-to-revenue, and enhanced client experience.

Recognized for fostering a risk excellence culture, strong governance, and continuous process improvement in global environments.

Worked with Companies Wipro (UBS), Société Generale, Deutsche bank & JP Morgan chase & co

CORE COMPETENCIES 

Client Onboarding & Compliance:
New Client Onboarding (NCO), KYC/AML, CDD/EDD, Client Lifecycle Management

Operations & Risk Management:
SLA/KPI/KRI Governance, Operational Risk, Internal Controls, Capital Markets Operations

Data & Process Excellence:
Reference Data Management, Account Setup, Process Transformation, Automation & STP

Stakeholder & Leadership:
Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management, Escalation Management, Team Leadership, Global Delivery

TECHNICAL SKILLS

SQL | Advanced Excel | Alteryx | Tableau | MS Office Suite | Workflow & Dashboard Tools

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Assistant Vice President – Client Onboarding & KYC

J.P. Morgan Chase, Bangalore | Jan 2023 – Present

Lead day-to-day operations of client onboarding teams (55+ FTEs) across ASIA & EMEA regions

Manage end-to-end onboarding lifecycle, including KYC updates, Account setup/maintenance for Individual & Corporate clients,

Led the implementation of Business Sustainability Controls (BSO) across key operational pillars (Onboarding, KYC, Account Maintenance), driving stronger control frameworks, audit readiness, and process standardization

Ensure adherence to SLA, KPI, and KRI metrics, with daily tracking of workflow queues and aged items

Collaborate with Relationship Managers (Bankers), Trading (Front office), Legal, Credit, and Operations teams to facilitate onboarding

Drive onboarding efficiency initiatives, reducing time-to-revenue and improving client experience

Handle escalations, issue resolution, and risk mitigation, ensuring timely closure and stakeholder communication

Lead technology and process enhancement initiatives, including automation and workflow improvements

Led KYC review and account update processes, ensuring timely periodic reviews, accurate capture of authorized signatories, and thorough documentation validation, thereby mitigating compliance risk and enhancing control effectiveness

Directing cross-functional global governance calls, aligning Front Office, Operations, Risk, and Compliance on KPI/KRI performance, risk identification, and resolution strategies, driving continuous improvement and strong control oversight.

Assistant Vice President – KYC Control Tower

Deutsche Bank, Bangalore | Jun 2022 – Jan 2023

Managed daily KYC reporting and data accuracy in alignment with global regulatory compliance frameworks, ensuring completeness and correctness of client information across bank reference systems. Actively monitored and resolved exceptions through structured exception management processes, collaborating with multiple operational teams responsible for updating and maintaining critical regulatory data.

Tracked and governed the KYC periodic review pipeline, ensuring all client accounts due for review were proactively identified, prioritized, and completed within defined timelines. Ensured mandatory KYC documentation and regulatory data were accurately onboarded and maintained in referential systems, minimizing compliance risk and avoiding regulatory breaches.

Partnered closely with global business units, Compliance, Risk, and Operations teams to enhance KYC reporting controls, strengthen data governance practices, and ensure adherence to evolving regulatory requirements across jurisdictions.

Supported audit readiness and internal control frameworks by conducting control checks, addressing audit observations, and implementing process improvements to enhance transparency, traceability, and regulatory compliance across KYC operations.

Delivery Manager – Client Onboarding & Reference Data

Société Générale, Bangalore | Nov 2016 – Jun 2022

Led day-to-day operations of the Reference Data Management function (32 FTEs) across India, ensuring seamless execution of client data maintenance, periodic reviews, and adherence to global regulatory and operational standards.

Oversaw end-to-end periodic review processes for client accounts, ensuring timely completion and accurate updating of static and regulatory data across internal referential systems (National registries, and third-party data providers) thereby maintaining high data integrity and compliance.

Delivered Straight-Through Processing (STP) and automation initiatives, enabling direct ingestion of static data from external providers into internal systems. This resulted in a 15% reduction in manual touchpoints during account creation and significantly improved operational efficiency and turnaround time.

Spearheaded process migrations and system enhancements, including workflow augmentation to enable automated data updates into referential systems, leading to improved data quality, reduced latency, and near real-time system synchronization

Engineered an API-driven financial data enrichment solution integrating third-party providers (Dun & Bradstreet, LexisNexis), enabling scalable processing of unlimited client accounts within 24 hours, reducing manual touchpoints and accelerating onboarding timelines

Led the design of comprehensive control and governance frameworks for system updates and downstream flows, enhancing data integrity, reducing risk exposure, and ensuring consistent data quality standards

Team Leader – Client Onboarding & Account Management

Wipro (Client: UBS), Bangalore | Feb 2009 – Nov 2016

Managed end-to-end Client & Credit Facilitation and Account Data Management (Run-the-Bank) for global trading accounts, including SSI (Standing Settlement Instructions) setup, data reconciliation, and account maintenance. Ensured full compliance with jurisdiction-specific regulatory requirements and internal control frameworks across multiple markets.

Played a key role in global process transition and migration initiatives, leading knowledge transfer and stabilization for a 20+ FTE operation. Successfully executed the end-to-end migration of Exchange Traded Derivatives (ETD) onboarding processes from Singapore to India, ensuring seamless transition, minimal disruption, and adherence to SLAs and control standards.

Delivered a multi-asset STP onboarding solution (Fixed Income, Equities, Derivatives), eliminating manual dependencies and transforming account setup into a streamlined, scalable, and high-efficiency process.

KEY ACHIEVEMENTS 

Optimised the data quality from 45% to 95%, enhancing quality and client satisfaction

Managed large-scale onboarding teams across multiple regions, ensuring SLA adherence and service delivery excellence

Led the design of comprehensive control and governance frameworks for system updates and downstream flows, improving data integrity by 30%+ and ensuring consistent data quality standards

Delivered 150% increase in onboarding capacity (10 to 25 accounts/day) through STP automation, enhancing scalability, efficiency, and operational performance

Led global onboarding migrations (20–40 FTEs) with strong governance and zero disruption

Developed automated KPI/KRI dashboards, improving transparency and decision-making

Reduced data and operational inefficiencies, contributing to cost optimization and improved controls

TRANSITION / MIGRATION 

Led end-to-end global transition of the Exchange Traded Derivatives (ETD) onboarding process from Singapore to India (20 FTE), including knowledge transfer, SOP development, and implementation of robust control frameworks, ensuring seamless migration and SLA adherence.

Successfully migrated a 35 FTE New Client Onboarding and Business Control (sustainability) function from Edinburgh to India, driving process stabilization, risk mitigation, and operational continuity while enhancing efficiency and governance standards.

KEY PROJECTS & IMPACT

Drove quality transformation initiatives, improving First Time Right (FTR) from 45% to 95% and significantly enhancing onboarding accuracy and client experience.

Led automation and STP initiatives, increasing onboarding capacity from 10 to 25 accounts/day and reducing manual intervention across workflows.

Developed real-time KPI/KRI dashboards (Alteryx), enabling data-driven decision-making, improved transparency, and stronger stakeholder reporting.

Delivered strategic cost and efficiency programs, including data offboarding (7% cost reduction) and value chain optimization, enhancing operational scalability and governance.

LEADERSHIP & PEOPLE MANAGEMENT

Lead, mentor, and develop Capital market operational teams, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement

Drive performance management, coaching, and succession planning

Promote a risk excellence culture, ensuring adherence to controls and compliance standards

Build strong working relationships across global teams and business units

Facilitate regular governance meetings with senior stakeholders, communicating risks, progress, and priorities

PROCESS, RISK & CONTROL GOVERNANCE

Monitor onboarding workflows, queues, and aged items to ensure 100% SLA compliance

Identify and mitigate operational risks, recommending process improvements

Strengthen internal control frameworks and audit readiness

Ensure adherence to global regulatory and compliance standards

Drive continuous improvement in onboarding processes and control environment

Supported audit readiness and internal control frameworks by conducting control checks, addressing audit observations, and implementing process improvements to enhance

EDUCATION

MBA (Finance) – University of Bangalore

B. Com (Accounts & Taxation) – University of Bangalore

CERTIFICATIONS

Anti-Money Laundering (AML) & Compliance Expert

Certified Compliance, Audit & Risk Management

PERSONAL DETAILS

Languages Known: English, Kannada, Hindi

Date of Birth: 11 December 1985

Address: No 60 Landmark apartment, 1st floor, 2nd house,

   Nanjundeshwara layout, JP nagar 5th phase

   Bangalore 560078
